Strongest recent work:

## Kora
Cross-border fintech platform. Gaoussou is a co-founder and founding full-stack engineer. Hands-on work spans the Flutter mobile app, Spring Boot backend, MySQL data architecture, React operations dashboard and Next.js public website. Engineering work includes KYC workflows, PayDunya payment integration, FCM mobile notifications, SSE admin updates, Google Cloud Storage document handling, operational monitoring, release preparation and contribution to Solana/USDT cross-border transfer integration.
Public website: https://koraworld.io

## Fidelity Market
Multi-platform marketplace work across Angular, Spring Boot and Flutter. Contributions include a major UX redesign, app-like mobile navigation, customer/seller/product/order/admin workflows, backend feature work, and a search redesign that moved away from repeated server-dependent exact matching toward cached client-side similarity and synonym matching.
Public website: https://fidelity-market.com

## AI Product Image & Publishing Pipeline
Operational human-in-the-loop e-commerce automation built with Python/FastAPI, Gemini API, Google Drive APIs and image-processing tools. The workflow groups product variants, routes categories, generates catalog assets, performs QA, records rejection reasons, keeps traceability, requires human approval and creates draft products rather than publishing AI output automatically.

Earlier work includes GeoTrac, a lost-item reporting/search/owner-matching platform built with Angular, Spring Boot and MySQL, and client WordPress/PHP website work at Aplika.

Professional positioning:
